title: Empowerment Program for Women & Widows Through Woman to Woman Network 21
imageAlt: Empowerment Program for Women & Widows Through Woman to Woman Network 21 2026
summary: Through Woman to Woman Network 21, Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo led a comprehensive empowerment distribution equipping women and widows with vocational tools, micro-enterprise grants, and cooperative training.
body:
Through Woman to Woman Network 21, Dr. Patience Ishaku Abbo led a comprehensive empowerment distribution equipping women and widows with vocational tools, micro-enterprise grants, and cooperative training.

The programme is designed to foster long-term economic independence and household resilience across rural and urban communities.
